architecture.modelTruth: Persistent raw-UTF16 Piece Tree on MainActor live state
architecture.mutation: All live changes enter one transaction gateway. Commits touching open MonaCode models use prepare, validate, atomic apply and deterministic event delivery. Closed-file or resource operations execute only through a host capability that advertises the required atomicity; otherwise the whole operation aborts before mutation.
architecture.projection: Synchronous ViewGraph and vertical indexes are the exact editor coordinate domain
architecture.typography: Core Text is the only production shaping, line-layout and hit-test authority
architecture.rendering: Core Graphics first; Metal is implemented only after a renderer-owned Q1 gate fails; both consume immutable LineLayoutRecord geometry
architecture.input: Custom NSTextInputClient, keybinding resolver, pointer/scroll adapter and transfer pipeline; NSTextView never owns model truth
architecture.language: Full provider registry and LSP 3.18 client infrastructure with plain-text fallback; host supplies server instances and byte transports
architecture.accessibility: A1-R2 raw-UTF16 text surface plus A2-R2 native widgets, proxies, focus modes and announcement broker

projection, folding, injected-text and editor state semantics

model, selection, command, cancellation and event traces for native input and widgets
nativeAdapted: Core Text geometry is internally self-consistent and Unicode-correct; it is not required to equal Blink/HarfBuzz numeric coordinates
AppKit control roles and focus behavior replace DOM/ARIA control mechanics while retaining observable actions and state
Core Graphics and conditional Metal pixels use native goldens and share one geometry record
equivalenceDomains.performance: For every Q1-R4 environment cell, native N must pass the intersection-union verdict against both M0 official Monaco and M1 capability-matched Monaco. Refresh rate selects frame budget; it never lowers the relative no-regression rule.

performanceDecision.metalTrigger: Only a failed renderer-owned metric after a correct full Core Graphics implementation triggers Metal work.
performanceDecision.metalNotTriggered: When every renderer-owned gate passes with Core Graphics, Metal is N/A and absent from the product.
performanceDecision.absoluteTimeout: No product-specific absolute timeout. External abort invalidates the whole block, and missing required valid blocks prevents a release verdict.

authorityRules.global: This manifest and its companion G3-R page replace G1-R and G2-R.
authorityRules.withinDomain: Later layers in one normativeDomains entry replace only conflicting clauses from earlier layers; all non-conflicting earlier clauses remain active.
crossDomainOverrides: P1-R replaces every dev-core identity or provenance claim in every domain.

F1-R3 and its scope and instance manifests own item identity, count, declaration multiplicity, inheritance, order and disposition for public editor instances, namespaces, options, registries, features and language content.
V1-R3/R4 replace every TextKit production backend, alternate typography backend and stale display-environment clause in architecture, transaction and input history.
I3-R4 owns public keyboard, pointer, scroll and context-menu event order; A1-R2 and A2-R2 call the same retained action paths.
L2-R3 owns LSP wire encoding, framing error direction and close policy.
A2-R2 owns retained feature accessibility disposition and must remain set-equal to F1-R3.
Q1-R4 owns benchmark environment identity, font provenance and cold-window handling; it retains the non-conflicting gates from Q1-R through Q1-R3.
authorityRules.sourceCounterexample: A conflict with a pinned artifact, public SDK contract, protocol snapshot or reproducible local probe invalidates the affected G3-R clause and requires a new manifest revision; prose never silently overrides source fact.
authorityRules.hashMismatch: A missing file or SHA-256 mismatch invalidates G3-R and blocks phase planning.
authorityRules.scopeChange: Any added, removed or reclassified feature, option, namespace key, platform, language content item or acceptance gate creates a new global revision before phase planning resumes.

phasePlanningAllowedWhen: All normative file hashes and all three machine artifact hashes validate
No new source counterexample remains open
designClosure.phaseRule: Phases may change implementation order only. They may not change this feature set, cuts, native adaptations, architecture decisions or acceptance thresholds.
